bluesky.text:
48 people who work with AI answered six questions. Two-thirds say AI is already replacing jobs in their field, or will within two years. Yet only 4 of the 48 feel strongly threatened.

They see it coming, and they are not afraid.

https://automato.substack.com/p/where-is-ai-heading-in-october-2026

OpenAI and Anthropic are racing to build data centers.
Apple seems to be doing the opposite.

The compute is already out there — in every Mac sold, every iPhone shipped.
Why centralize when the infrastructure is already in people's hands?

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-250345956

We keep trying the same patterns, even when they’ve stopped working. Not because we’re foolish, but because we’re good at them; our competence is part of the bubble!

https://growingfearless.substack.com/p/is-your-bubble-bursting

You don't need to sell software anymore — you engineer a prompt and give it to your customer.
They customize it themselves.

The prompt guides them through connectors, databases, apps.
And improvements? Also in the prompt.

https://substack.com/@joseantoniomorales/note/c-234013646
